  "memo":"R03 holds: the US-issued card was used from Canada, with failed AVS and CVV. Card is the only adverse family; all other rule conditions are absent. No household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles this order. No check has completed. Legitimate use of a foreign-issued card from the customer's home country remains plausible, but requires verification. Recommend needs_check under FP-2 §6.6(b), implemented by the analyst as a hold with id_check. That check is the cheapest decision-changing option and establishes both card possession and account identity. Decline is not permitted on the current single-family evidence."
